About the Healthy Living event

Healthy Living is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: testing · speech & presentation.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Healthy Living solo event, following the 2026–27 test plan built from the NASM HOSA Healthy Living Course (nutrition 25%, physical activity 25%, wellness through the lifespan 20%, disease prevention 20%, mental health 10%) and the Round Two portfolio presentation: writing a challenging but attainable SMART goal, completing a baseline health assessment, documenting the journey and presenting it in five minutes. Includes calorie, %DV, heart-rate and progress calculations, prevention and lifespan sorting and practice scenarios.

Sample Healthy Living questions

1. Which is the best warm-up before a soccer practice?

  1. Long static hamstring holds
  2. Maximal sprints right away
  3. Lying still to save energy
  4. Light jogging and leg swings
Show answer

D. Light jogging and leg swings

Dynamic movements raise muscle temperature and mimic the activity; static stretching fits better after exercise.

2. Which claim is the strongest red flag for a fad diet?

  1. Eat more fiber and whole grains
  2. Rapid weight loss with no exercise
  3. Drink water throughout the day
  4. Limit added sugars and sodium
Show answer

B. Rapid weight loss with no exercise

Promises of fast results without effort, single “miracle” foods and banned food groups are warning signs.

3. A runner stops training for two months and loses endurance. Which principle explains this?

  1. Reversibility
  2. Specificity
  3. Overload
  4. Individuality
Show answer

A. Reversibility

Fitness gains are lost when training stops; specificity means adaptations match the activity.
